app.title: ClaimPilot
app.tagline: File a motor claim by chat. Answers cite your selected policy or clearly labelled demo wording; a human adjuster reviews every case.
chat.placeholder: Describe what happened to your car…
chat.placeholderReviewed: Chat is paused. See the claim status and available actions.
chip.event_type: Someone hit my parked car and left
chip.third_party_involved: No other vehicle or person was involved
card.title: Claim card
card.factsEmpty: Tell me what happened and the facts will appear here.
card.coverageEmpty: Coverage is checked against the policy wording once the key facts are known.
card.riskDisclaimer: Decision support only – a model signal with reasons, never a verdict. Reviewed by a human.
card.riskEmpty: Appears after the facts are complete.
card.cost: Typical claim for this profile: ≈ €{claim} (portfolio €{portfolio}), {freq} claims/year expected
card.adjusterToken: Adjuster token (only claims staff can review a claim):
card.readyToSubmit: Your claim summary is ready. Send it to an adjuster when you are ready.
card.submitted: Your claim has been sent and is waiting for an adjuster to review it.
queue.title: Reviewer queue
queue.help: Claims waiting for an authorized reviewer. The credential stays in memory until you lock or leave this screen.
queue.empty: No claims are waiting for review.
queue.choose: Choose a claim to see its facts, coverage references and risk reasons.
card.replyInstructions: Reply in the chat, then submit the updated claim for review again.
card.requestDetails: What information does the customer need to provide?
card.refreshRequired: The saved guidance is out of date. Refresh the assessment before completing the review.
queue.invalidCorrection: The correction is not valid. Check the date (YYYY-MM-DD), time (HH:MM), amount and yes/no answers, then try again.
history.title: Claim history
history.availability: History records actions since this feature was added. Earlier activity may not appear here.
history.empty: No actions have been recorded yet.
history.loadFailed: History could not be loaded. Check your access or try again.
history.tokenMemory: Use your demo or reviewer token. It stays only in memory until you leave this page.
customer.invalidCorrection: The changes were not saved. Use a valid date (YYYY-MM-DD), time (HH:MM) and a nonnegative amount.
customer.invalidDate: Enter a real date in YYYY-MM-DD format.
customer.invalidTime: Enter a valid time in HH:MM format.
customer.invalidAmount: Enter an amount of zero or more.
risk.needed: To calculate a risk signal, provide:
risk.unavailable: Risk signal temporarily unavailable. A human can still review this claim.
uncertainty.missing_policy_wording: The available policy wording does not establish coverage for this claim.
uncertainty.conflicting_evidence: The available information conflicts, so coverage needs human review.
uncertainty.human_review: Coverage needs a claims handler’s review.
uncertainty.next.missing_facts: Check and complete the missing details listed above.
uncertainty.next.missing_policy_wording: Provide the relevant wording from your actual policy for a claims handler to check.
uncertainty.next.conflicting_evidence: Ask a claims handler to compare the conflicting information before deciding.
uncertainty.next.human_review: Send the claim for review or respond to the reviewer’s request for details.
uncertainty.preliminary: This is preliminary guidance using model terms. A cited clause is a reference, not proof of cover or a payment decision.
chat.sendFailed: Your message could not be completed. Retry to continue with the same text and attachment.
session.unavailable: We could not open your saved claim. It may be missing, access may be required, or the service may be unavailable. Retry or start a new claim.
session.memory: The token stays in memory and must be entered again after a page refresh.
session.newNote: Starting a new claim keeps the previous claim saved. This browser will return to the new claim.
session.pending: Your last message is unfinished. Retry to continue with the saved message and attachment.
policy.title: Policy document
policy.demo: Answers currently use standard GDV AKB 2015 demo wording.
policy.sample: Use a sample policy in this shared demo. Policy uploads are separate from claim evidence.
policy.limit: PDF only, up to {mb} MB; at most 300 pages.
policy.notUsed: Your file is saved. Its text is not yet prepared for coverage searches; answers still use demo wording.
policy.locked: Policy uploads are available before submission.
policy.loadFailed: Could not load policy details. Please retry.
policy.tooLarge: The PDF exceeds the upload size limit.
policy.invalid: This PDF could not be accepted. Use an unencrypted, valid PDF with 1–300 pages.
policy.conflict: A policy is already attached, a message is unfinished, or this claim has been submitted.
policy.failed: The upload could not be completed. Your current policy selection is unchanged. Please retry.
policy.preparedNotUsed: The policy text is prepared. Coverage answers still use standard demo wording until policy-based answers are enabled.
policy.prepareEncrypted: This policy is password protected. Use an unencrypted PDF.
policy.prepareUnreadable: Readable text could not be prepared from every nonempty page. Use a text-based PDF; scanned images need OCR.
policy.prepareLimit: This policy exceeds the preparation limits. Use a smaller policy PDF.
policy.prepareTimeout: Preparation took too long. Retry or use a smaller text-based PDF.
policy.prepareFailed: Policy preparation could not be completed. Retry when the service is available.
policy.processingElsewhere: This policy is still being prepared. Check again shortly.
policy.usedForNew: New coverage assessments use this policy. Refresh any older assessment marked out of date.
policy.noAnswersYet: This policy is not ready for coverage searches. Prepare its text or ask a claims handler for review.
uncertainty.policyPreliminary: This is preliminary guidance from the selected policy passages. A citation is a reference, not proof of coverage or a payment decision.
policy.confirmText: Replace {current} with {name}? Previous guidance will be out of date until this file is prepared and the assessment refreshed.
policy.replacementPending: Prepare this replacement, then refresh the claim assessment. Previous guidance remains out of date.
policy.sameFile: This file has the same content as the selected policy. The current selection is unchanged.
policy.replacementConflict: The current policy changed, is processing, or the claim is no longer editable. Reload the selection before trying again.
evidence.title: Claim attachments
evidence.state.unknown: Older upload; type and processing have not been verified.
evidence.state.stored: Uploaded. Not yet analysed for claim details.
evidence.uploadInvalid: This attachment could not be accepted. Choose a readable PDF, JPEG, PNG or WebP file with the matching file extension. PDFs cannot be labelled as damage photos. Your message is back in the draft.
evidence.uploadTooLarge: This file is too large. Choose a file of 10 MB or less. Your message is back in the draft.
evidence.uploadUnsupported: This file type is not supported. Choose a PDF, JPEG, PNG or WebP file. Your message is back in the draft.
evidence.state.processing: Reading PDF. Claim facts are unchanged.
evidence.state.ready: PDF read. Check the decision shown for each suggestion.
evidence.notConfirmed: Document suggestions only change claim facts after you accept them. Check each detail against the source document.
evidence.noSuggestions: No supported claim details were found in this document.
evidence.readUnreadable: We could not read all the document text. Use a readable, unencrypted PDF with selectable text. Scanned images need a text version.
evidence.readTooLong: This document has too much text to read in one request. Use a shorter PDF (up to 40,000 characters).
evidence.readFailed: We could not finish reading this PDF. Your claim facts are unchanged. Please retry reading it.
evidence.conflict: This differs from the saved value. Choose which value is correct.
evidence.replaceValue: Replace the saved value with this suggestion.
evidence.decision.accepted: Accepted earlier. The saved value above shows the current claim.
evidence.decision.rejected: Rejected. This suggestion did not change the claim.
evidence.pendingDecision: A document decision needs to finish before you change this claim.
evidence.changed: The claim details changed or another action needs to finish. Check the current saved details before deciding again.
evidence.decisionFailed: Your document decision could not be completed. Retry to finish the same decision.
evidence.finishPrevious: Finish the earlier failed action using Retry before deciding on a document suggestion.
evidence.emptyPdf: This PDF is empty. Upload a copy containing the document text, or enter the details yourself.
evidence.scannedPdf: This PDF has no selectable text. It may be a scan or image. Upload a text-based PDF or enter the details yourself; scans are not read automatically.
evidence.partialPdf: We could not read all pages. No document suggestions were saved. Upload a clearer text-based copy or enter the details yourself.
evidence.damagedPdf: This PDF is damaged or cannot be opened. Export a new PDF copy or enter the details yourself.
evidence.protectedPdf: This PDF is password-protected. Upload a copy without a password or enter the details yourself.
evidence.sameCopy: This copy is identical to the current upload. Choose a different copy or enter the details yourself.
evidence.draftRestored: Your message is back in the draft.
evidence.manualHint: You can enter the details in the claim facts or in a chat message instead.
evidence.previousCopy: Previous copy — kept for reference; its suggestions cannot be applied.
evidence.confirmCopy: Replace {old} with {next}? The previous copy will be kept.
evidence.copyTooLarge: This copy is too large. Choose a smaller PDF.
evidence.copyPdfRequired: Choose a PDF file for this replacement.
evidence.copyInvalid: This copy could not be accepted. Choose a readable PDF with a matching .pdf file extension.
evidence.copyConflict: Another action is running or a newer copy is already saved. Check the current copy before trying again.
evidence.replaceFailed: The replacement could not be completed. Retry with the same copy to finish without creating duplicates.
evidence.decision.superseded: Previous suggestion — this copy was replaced.
evidence.emptyFile: This file is empty. Choose a file with contents or enter the details yourself.
